extension_bars_frozen.SWAP-JOINS: the swap arm's full-fit residuals co-move with BOTH warm arms at the shared in-band reshape steps: Pearson r(swap, anneal) >= +0.50 AND r(swap, walk_cons) >= +0.50 — the co-movement is phase-general (a stream/draw-side signature), not warm-specific.
